title: StateKit fixture
description: Language-independent scenario format driving Go harnesses and container runs (plans/init.md section 25, plans/testing.md).

command.description: argv passed to the statekit binary after the program name. The token __TMPDIR__ is substituted with a fresh temporary directory when tmpdir is true.

stdin.description: Optional bytes piped to the process stdin channel.

contains.description: Every substring must appear in stdout.

stderr-contains.description: Every substring must appear in stderr.

json.description: Recursive subset match against stdout parsed as JSON; expected keys must exist with equal (or recursively matching) values.

tmpdir.description: Allocate a fresh temp dir and substitute __TMPDIR__ tokens in command args and json expectations.

hosts-file.description: Content for a hermetic hosts file supplied to the binary through its validated runtime hosts-path override.

source.description: Path of the Salt reference implementation inside the pinned tree.

symbol.description: Referenced function symbol in the Salt source file.

test.description: Related Salt test file inside the pinned tree.

requires-root.description: Fixture needs root privileges; skipped by unprivileged harnesses, executed in root containers.
